name: sitio-multitrem
description: E-commerce Sítio Multitrem - Hortaliças Frescas e Ovos Caipiras

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n "product,cart,order,payment,auth,whatsapp,ai" -c "blue,green,yellow,red,magenta,cyan,white" "npm run dev:product" "npm run dev:cart" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:whatsapp" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: cd shared && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.js || bash scripts/setup.sh || powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup.ps1
